page_title: MAR 1-1 STR | Marseille v Strasbourg 12/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' The corner is swung in but Marseille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+5' The referee shows a yellow card to Samuel Gigot (Marseille). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
90+5' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
90+5' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) will take a corner kick.
90+4' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
90+1' 1 - 1 Goal! Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
90+1' Noam Mayoka-Tika (Marseille) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marc Bollengier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' The referee signals a substitution. Noam Mayoka-Tika (Marseille) is brought on as a substitute for Bilal Nadir.
88' Bilal Nadir (Marseille) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
88' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) jumps into a tackle and Marc Bollengier signals a foul.
86' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) wins the ball from the free kick and fires in an amazing shot at goal which thumps against the crossbar!
84' Bilal Nadir (Marseille) has tested the patience of referee Marc Bollengier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
81' Strasbourg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
79' Patrick Vieira decides to make a substitution. Marvin Senaya will be replaced by Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg).
79' Here's the change. Angelo leaves the pitch and Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) comes on as a substitute.
77' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
76' Vitinha (Marseille) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marc Bollengier no option but to blow his whistle.
75' Wonderful movement by Strasbourg. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
73' Problems for Gennaro Gattuso as Geoffrey Kondogbia is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Jean Onana (Marseille) replaces him.
72' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
71' Marseille couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Matz Sels (Strasbourg) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
70' Strasbourg fail to score from a corner as Pau Lopez (Marseille) leaps to collect the ball.
68' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Strasbourg was in an offside position.
67' Strasbourg fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
65' Corner kick. Marseille will have an opportunity.
64' That will be all from Kevin Gameiro who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg).
64' A corner kick by Strasbourg is thwarted by the well prepared Pau Lopez (Marseille).
62' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
61' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Marc Bollengier stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
59' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
58' The Strasbourg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
56' The ball possession is 45:55.
54' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle and signals a foul after Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) brought his opponent down.
53' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles past the left post.
52' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
52' Vitinha (Marseille) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
50' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
49' Angelo (Strasbourg) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
48' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
47' Wonderful movement by Strasbourg. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
46' The whistle blows and Marc Bollengier starts the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' The corner from Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) is cleared away by the defence.
43' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
42' Vitinha (Marseille) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
42' The game is interrupted now, Vitinha (Marseille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
41' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
40' A cross into the box from Vitinha (Marseille) is cleared.
37' Marc Bollengier interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille).
35' That's a clear yellow card. Abdoul Bamo Meite (Marseille) goes into the book.
34' Michael Murillo (Marseille) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.

33' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) makes contact with a cross but fails to connect perfectly. His low drive heads straight towards the middle of the goal where the goalkeeper makes a decent save to deny him.
31' Abdoul Bamo Meite (Marseille) trips an opposition player and Marc Bollengier signals a foul.
31' Angelo (Strasbourg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
30' Strasbourg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
28' Vitinha (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
26' Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
25' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar.
23' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
21' Angelo (Strasbourg) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
19' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:2.
18' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
17' Marseille are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
16' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
15' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Strasbourg.
15' Great save! Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Pau Lopez.
14' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
14' Bilal Nadir (Marseille) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for an infringement.
11' A cross from a corner kick by Marseille is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
11' Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) serves up a nice cross, but Pau Lopez punches the ball away.

10' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Marseille are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
8' The game is interrupted. Samuel Gigot (Marseille) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
8' A pass by Jordan Veretout (Marseille) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

6' Strasbourg slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
5' Marc Bollengier sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
4' The Marseille players halt their celebrations as referee Marc Bollengier makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
3' 1 - 0 Samuel Gigot (Marseille) leaps to connect with a delightful cross and places his sweet header into the roof of the net. The goalkeeper had no chance to make a save.
3' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
2' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
1' A long pass, executed by Abdoul Bamo Meite (Marseille), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Marseille will kick the game off.
